description: Polymarket in-play ticket dataset - every settled in-play bet this desk placed: fixture, minute, book price at entry, our model probability, edge, stake, settled PnL and the rule version that fired it. Every settled loss is in there, plus the rows where our model scored worse than the market. The same tape that produced our published v4.1 rule. Free sample at /x402/dataset/preview.
name: akari_inplay_tickets
